Vacancy for Research Assistant
Saturday, 14 May 2022
3870 Hits
Applications are invited on plain paper for the post of  ‘Research Assistant’   in ICMR- funded project entitled
"Development and Validation of Artificial Intelligence Tool for Screening/detection of Pulmonary TB and other lung diseases using Chest X-rays”
under Department of Microbiology, Mahatma Gandhi of Medical Sciences, Sevagram as per details given below:
Sr. No.
Name of Post
No of post
Minimum qualification required (Recognized Uni./ Institute)
Age
Consolidated monthly salary
(Fixed)
1
Research Assistant
01
Graduate in Science/ relevant subjects/ from a recognized university with 3years work experience.
OR
Master’s degree in the relevant subject
Candidates with work experience.and with good computer knowledge will be preferred
Below 30 years
31,000/-
Note:
Interested Candidates fulfilling the above conditions are required to submit – their complete bio-data duly signed and enclosing photocopies of certificates/testimonials in support of date of birth, qualification/ experience etc. & affixed with latest photograph
on or before 19
th
May 2022 by 1.00 pm
in the office of the department. The applications should be addressed to the undersigned and should include Name, Age, Gender, address including mobile number and email id, essential qualifications and experience.
The engagement in the project is purely on temporary basis maximum for the period of duration of the project. However, appointment will initially be offered for the period of one month to be extended or terminated depending upon satisfactory performance and co-terminus with the project.
The salary is consolidated and No benefits of any allowance, PF, LTC, Medical claim, Medical facility etc are admissible.
The Principal Investigator reserves the right to shortlist the candidates depending on the number of applications and other requirements of the project and/ or not to fill the above post/s without assigning any reason.
Interview date and venue of the interview will be informed to the short listed candidates by telephone / email.
---
Dr. (Mrs) Pratibha Narang
,
Principal Investigator,
Development and Validation of AI Tool for Screening/detection of Pulmonary TB and other lung diseases using Chest X-rays (ICMR AI Tool TB project)
Emeritus Professor
Department. Of Microbiology,
MGIMS, Sevagram
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
